Old laundry and back deck removed. Asbestos-free report is in Files.
Footings passed inspection on 8 Jul. Slab poured the next day.
Wall and roof frames up and braced. Frame inspection passed on 30 Jul.
Roof, windows and external doors in, so the house is locked up and weatherproof.
Walls and ceilings sheeted, then the laundry and bathroom are waterproofed.
Cabinets, benchtops and splashback go in, then floor and wall tiling.
Lights, power points, taps and fixtures are fitted, then two coats of paint.
Final clean and walkthrough together. You get the keys and the warranty pack.
